caption: The video captures a nighttime wildfire burning behind a silhouetted foreground of low buildings and tall palm trees, the sky glowing deep red-orange. Bright flames already rage along the left edge and across the right side behind rooftops, while a lit window glows in the central silhouette. In the lower center-right, a vehicle-like cluster of small red and two white lights holds a fixed position. The flames on the left flicker and change shape, tongues of fire rising and shifting in height. The fire line on the right deforms and pulses, the tall flame column near the right-center palm growing and shifting. The overall red glow brightens and dims slightly as the fire's intensity varies. The silhouetted palms, building outlines, lit window, and foreground lights remain largely in place, with the fire and glow the main visible changes.
